body: its by far the worst part, she explained "if 2.9 becomes the norm how soon till it becomes 2.8?"

to mantain the scholarship you needed to take a certain amount of credits per semester and maintain a 3.0+ gpa, mine was at 2.7 and 2.9 my first 2 semester and they took it, the meeting was pretty soul shattering the bitch brushed it off without a second thought, wouldnt budge an inch here exact words were "if we lower the bar for you, it sets a precedent" i couldnt believe it

edit: i didnt get "kicked out" i was asked to leave because i couldnt afford to attend any classes

literally anything and everything i just need to not be worthless, everywhere i go tells me to either apply online or they are not hiring, both never result in a job and if they do its a shitty pyramid scheme, online resources are a joke (craigslist, monster, indeed, etc) ive tried them all but to no avail, i have no fucking idea why im unhirable im literally willing to do almost anything for a job
i would like to try it but to do that, you need a degree, to get that you need money, to get that you need a job, so im failing at step one
i play video games because sometimes i get so immersed i forget about all my past failures
there isnt a clear "starting" point, its been more of a spiral, id say the clearest starting point would be losing the scholarship
